verdict.rationale: Docs say Bugbot re-runs automatically on every PR update and reads existing top-level and inline PR comments to avoid duplicate suggestions and build on prior feedback. That covers the re-review trigger and the de-duplication intent. However, nothing documents incremental (since-last-review) diff scoping or tracking and resolving previously flagged issues once fixed. One hands-on report also describes Bugbot re-raising its original recommendation after the user pushed back and reverted the change. missing for 10: documented incremental review of only new commits, explicit tracking or auto-resolution of fixed findings, independent corroboration that old comments are not repeated.
